Title: Integration of Azure Backup into VM create experience

Body.Content:
Azure Backup now gives you the ability to enable backup on virtual machines from VM create experience in the portal. With this announcement, we are bringing the ability to protect the VMs with an enterprise-grade backup solution from the moment of VM creation. This adds to support for backing up virtual machines from VM management blade.

Read the announcement blog for more details.
